goal: Obtain 3-5 clean image-only H45 candidates with the exact factual source anchor, unchanged viewpoint/composition and native output raster adequate for the wide physical-use target.

attempts.reason: Returned an infographic/report containing multiple self-declared candidates, metrics and verdicts instead of image-only masters. Embedded product imagery also converges on the same non-source fantasy telescopic-slide prototype seen across the repeated attempts.

Returned another research dashboard rather than a clean edited product image, despite explicit source-reference anchoring. Embedded product imagery again depicts essentially the same plausible but incorrect slide prototype rather than the factual two-piece H45 source.

Returned an infographic board with embedded candidate imagery and generated gate claims rather than image-only native masters. The candidate set repeats the same incorrect learned/prototypical slide geometry instead of providing independent faithful H45 reconstructions.

independentFactualFinding.note: The visually promising prior candidate becomes a factual failure when compared to the exact H45 source: the source has two separate slide pieces and the generated rail topology/hole patterns/terminal structures materially differ.

crossRunFinding.humanObservation: Across the repeated dashboard attempts, the generated product imagery repeatedly uses essentially the same fantasy telescopic-slide design rather than independently preserving the factual H45 source.
crossRunFinding.interpretation: Cross-run similarity is not fidelity evidence here. It indicates mode/prototype convergence toward a learned plausible drawer-slide representation that overrides source identity.
crossRunFinding.risk: The wrong product can look coherent and repeatable enough to appear trustworthy unless compared against source landmarks.

interpretation: The producer demonstrates strong visual plausibility for furniture hardware but currently poor contract reliability in this session.
Visual plausibility and source fidelity must remain separate gates.
The repeated report-output behavior prevents measuring native master resolution or a true 3-5-sample factual pass rate.
The experiment should not be converted into a success by extracting report imagery and treating it as native masters.
Repeated similarity between generated candidates is currently evidence of systematic wrong-prototype convergence, not evidence of faithful repeatability.
stopDecision: Do not spend further samples on the same producer/channel in this experiment unless the editing channel behavior changes materially.
nextUsefulHypothesis: Keep the source-grounded capability hypothesis open, but require a producer that can return image-only edits and preserve source landmark topology before testing viewpoint change or production policy.
